notes: Instance lifecycle uses the scalar instance detail API and documented state enums. EIP binding status is nested under nodeList rather than the instance object, and the detail command has no scalar node identity input; no ambiguous EIP waiter is emitted.
Node status query returns multiple nodes without a scalar node selector input. Fault-drill list contains per-task states but accepts no task identity input; no first-row readiness is inferred.
Topic and consumer status APIs report offsets and metrics, not documented lifecycle completion; rebalance and migration submission acknowledgements are not completion evidence.

request_notes: State-changing POST requests are confirmed and not retried; pricing and retrieval requests remain read-only.
Preserve documented conditional requirements for renewal, remote storage, sorting, offset reset, migration, partition rebalancing, legacy ACL resource types and prepaid pricing.
Legacy ACL recommendations resolve to visible user permission commands and do not mark still-published APIs deprecated.

Sort direction is conditionally required whenever request-sort is supplied. The metadata condition model has equality/set comparisons but no presence predicate, so this dependency is explained in help and remains server-validated.
response_notes: The malformed quota examples omit the explicitly documented returnObj.data key before true; restore that key, retaining the original evidence, and reject data=false even under a successful outer status.
Six schema-only or absent examples do not become fabricated offline fixtures.
